88
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, March 20, 2018/Phalguna 29, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Finance; Health and Family
Welfare; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power)
Total number of questions — 15
Steps taken to address the high MMR
*256. SHRI MANISH GUPTA: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the steps taken by Government to
address the high maternal mortality ratio
(MMR) in India;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
address alleged and increasing reports of
obstetric violence, i.e., the abuse of pregnant
women by health workers, if any; and
(c)  the steps taken by Government to
address the alleged violation of consent of
pregnant women during delivery, especially
the performance of episiotomy procedures
without obtaining informed consent?
Waiver of inter-State power
transmission charges
*257. SHRI T. RATHINAVEL: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has extended the waiver of inter-State
power transmission charges and losses of
solar and wind projects commissioned till
March 31, 2022;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
waiver was available for a period of  25
years from the date of commissioning of
the project; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Scientifically validated Ayurvedic
drug molecules
*258. DR. VIKAS MAHATME: Will
the Minister of  AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NA TUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of new drug molecules of
Ayurvedic medicines which are validated
scientifically and introduced in market;

89
(b) how much revenue generation has
been made by marketing such molecule
introduced, if any; and
(c) the future policy of Government for
these types of research and how much is
the fund allotted for research in Ayurveda?
Setting up of Ayurvedic colleges in
Chhattisgarh
†*259. DR. BHUSHAN LAL
JANGDE: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether setting up of Ayurvedic
Colleges in Bastar division and Ambikapur
region in Chhattisgarh is in the public
interest in view of abundant availability of
herbs and forest medicines there;
(b) whether quality medicines can be
manufactured by setting up quality
ayurvedic pharmacies in these regions, so
as to encourage indigenous medicines; and
(c) whether Government would focus
on improving pharmacy for manufacturing
existing medicines as it is not possible to
manufacture medicines as per requirement
in the absence of supervision of Raipur
Ayurvedic Pharmacy?
Demonetisation impact on corruption
†*260. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
YADA V: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that demonetisation
could not get expected results in stopping
the corruption for which it was intended
by Government;
(b) whether it is a fact that old currencies
in the denominations of  ` 500 and  ` 1000
still continue to be seized in the raids; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Merging of laws into Government
Savings Promotion Act
*261. SHRIMATI VIJILA
SATHYANANTH: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering to merge various laws into a
Government Savings Promotion Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the move
is aimed at removing ambiguities;
(d) whether the main objective in
proposing a common Act is to make
implementation easier for the depositors
as they need not go through different Rules
and Acts; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Strengthening the security of banks/
ATMs
*262. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of incidents of robbery,
fraud and attack on customers in banks,
cash vans, Automated T eller Machines
(ATMs) etc., reported in various parts of
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

the country during the last three years and
in the current year, bank-wise and State-
wise;
(b) whether Reserve Bank of India
issued any guidelines to banks regarding
safety and security of banks/ATMs and if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures taken by Government
or RBI to strengthen the security of  banks,
cash vans and  ATMs, by using latest
modern technology to prevent and deal with
such incidents in future?
Amount involved in LoUs issued by
banks
*263. DR. SUBRAMANIAN
SWAMY: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) how many Letters of Undertaking
(LoUs) were issued since 2011, year-wise,
as well as number of  LoUs issued till May
26, 2014 and thereafter;
(b) the amount involved in each
LoU;
(c) the period for which the LoU was
valid according to the LoUs for 90 days,
180 days and 365 days or more;
(d) how much money was withdrawn
from the foreign branch of  the other banks

(Ministries: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Finance; Health and Family
Welfare; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power)
Total number of questions — 160
Practitioners of AYUSH medicines
system
2721. SHRIMA TI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPA THY be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of registered
practitioners under A YUSH system of
medicines in the country, State/UT-wise
including Himachal Pradesh;
(b) the details of institutions/hospitals
imparting medical education in AYUSH at
various levels in the country, State/
UT-wise including Himachal Pradesh;
(c) whether Government has received
proposals from State Governments to
open/upgrade AYUSH institutions,
colleges, universities, hospitals, health
centres, research centres in the country
including Himachal Pradesh, if so, details
thereof along with action taken thereon;
and
(d) the details of funds earmarked,
allocated and utilised for the purpose during
each of last three years and current year,
State/UT-wise including Himachal Pradesh?
 Promotion of Ayurveda
2722. SHRI NARAYAN LAL
PANCHARIYA: W ill the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NA TUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has taken any
steps to promote Ayurveda in public health
care system;
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has started any
programme to provide assistance to
institutions engaged in ayurvedic drug
development and research; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, if not, the
reasons therefor?

641
New leukemia treatment by Ayurvedic
Sciences
2723. SHRI NARENDRA KUMAR
SW AIN: Will the Minister of AYURVEDA,
YOGA & NATUROP ATHY , UNANI,
SIDDHA AND HOMOEOPATHY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that treatment of
relapsed undifferentiated acute myeloid
leukemia was invented by a member of
Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic
Sciences;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether alternative medicine is
marketed and produced by Government;
and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 AYUSH hospitals in the country
2724. SHRI D. KUPENDRA REDDY:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government had planned
to establish about 50 AYUSH hospitals in
the country under Centrally Sponsored
Scheme/National AYUSH Mission;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the locations wherein these hospitals have
been/are being established, State-wise;
(c) the present status of these hospitals
and whether these hospitals have started
functioning; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
 Authentication labs for Ayush
medicines
†2725. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that "Ayush"
medicines have been used for centuries,
despite not being authenticated by any
authorized laboratory;
(b) if so, whether Government proposes
to restrict the use of Ayush medicines not
authenticated by authorized labs and
whether it would consider establishing
authentication labs for these medicines; and
(c) if so, by when and if not, reasons
therefor?
 Y oga and Naturopathy treatment
facilities
†2726. SHRI RAM NATH THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to provide better treatment
facility to the people through Yoga and
Naturopathy;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the number of  Yoga colleges set up
in the country so far, and the details thereof
including those opened in Bihar?
 RARIGID, Guwahati
